goal: Rebuild CodeRef Core intelligence index (index.json + graph.json + semantic-registry.json + reports + RAG vectors) for the primary-sources repo over its current HEAD, using local Ollama only, then report scan stats + drift findings to PRIMARY-SOURCES and ASSISTANT.
plan_type_rationale: Operational index-refresh job: runs scan + rag-index tooling against an external target repo. No source modification, no code blast radius, no foundation-docs discovery. Light is correct.

phases.name: Rescan + reindex primary-sources (local Ollama)
phases.description: Verify prereqs, run structural scan, rebuild RAG vectors locally, verify index health, capture stats vs the May-14 baseline, and report to both requester and dispatcher.

tasks.description: Confirm Ollama is UP at localhost:11434 with nomic-embed-text:latest + qwen2.5-coder:3b, and confirm scan target path C:/Users/willh/Desktop/CODEREF/PROJECTS/primary-sources exists with current HEAD. (Pre-verified at WO authoring; re-confirm at execution start.)
Read the existing .coderef/index.json + reports baseline (May-14) to capture pre-rescan stats (file count, symbol count, index size) for the drift comparison.
Run coderef-scan against the primary-sources repo to rebuild .coderef/index.json + graph.json + semantic-registry.json + reports/. Provider: local only.
Run rag-index for primary-sources using nomic-embed-text via local Ollama to rebuild the RAG vector store. If Ollama drops mid-embed, STOP and andon-pull to ASSISTANT.
Run rag-status / inspect rebuilt artifacts to verify index health: confirm index.json, graph.json, semantic-registry.json freshly written (new mtime), RAG vectors present, no scan errors.

Capture scan stats (files scanned, symbols, index size, RAG chunks/vectors, wall-clock elapsed) and compute drift vs the May-14 baseline (delta file/symbol counts, notable new subtrees: STAFF/, curator scripts, FastAPI backend, reviewer UI). Record into communication.json result + an execution-notes.md.
Report completion + stats + drift findings to BOTH PRIMARY-SOURCES (requester, via dispatch result) and ASSISTANT (GO dispatcher CODEREF-CORE-002 result field).
